description: A parsed safe binding expression. Public parsing APIs never throw on malformed input: they return a literal-mode instance with IsMalformed set to true. The only permitted function call is token(key); any other call becomes a parse error and is handled by the same literal fallback. Parse once and hand the instance to StencilEvaluator.Evaluate to avoid re-parsing in hot render paths.

examples.title: Parse once, evaluate many times
